seoTitle: The Bear Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take The Bear test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Carmy, Sydney, Richie, Marcus, Tina, Natalie, Neil or Uncle Jimmy — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the perfectionist chef, the loud and loyal cousin, or the one quietly holding it all together? Answer 11 everyday questions about work, family and pressure, and find out which Bear character you are.

characters.name: Carmy Berzatto
characters.title: The Perfectionist
characters.summary: Brilliant, intense and impossible to satisfy. You'll redo it a hundred times until it's perfect, and you're always hardest on yourself.
description: Like Carmy, you're brilliant at what you do. He left Chicago young to train as a chef, and became one of the top names in American cooking.
You show up for family, even when it's hard. After his brother Mikey dies, Carmy comes home to run Mikey's failing Italian beef restaurant.
You're your own harshest critic. On the Bear's friends-and-family night, Carmy gets locked in the broken walk-in fridge and spirals into self-doubt.
characters.flaw: You can't switch off, and you shut people out when you need them most.
characters.signature: A spotless kitchen, a new idea and a dish you'll redo until it's perfect.
characters.clashReason: they'd redo your work without asking, then apologise for it later

characters.name: Sydney Adamu
characters.title: The Rising Star
characters.summary: Talented, ambitious and always thinking three steps ahead. You've got big plans, and you want to get them exactly right.
description: Like Sydney, you're talented and ambitious. She's a classically trained chef who studied at the Culinary Institute of America.
You've learned from your mistakes. Sydney's own catering business failed, and it left her in debt.
You think hard before you commit. In season 4, Sydney turns down a job offer from another chef, Adam Shapiro.
characters.flaw: You overthink every decision until you've talked yourself out of it.
characters.signature: A neat station, a plan for everything and an idea you can't wait to try.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a plan for everything, including your plans

characters.name: Richie Jerimovich
characters.title: The Cousin
characters.summary: Loud, loyal and all heart. You fight change, then throw yourself into it, and you'd do anything for the people you love.
description: Like Richie, you're loud, loyal and impulsive. He was Mikey's best friend, and he's family to the Berzattos, even though he isn't related.
You find your calling when you least expect it. Richie trains front of house at one of the best restaurants in Chicago, and comes back as the Bear's maître d'.
You've got a big heart. Richie sings along to Taylor Swift in the car, because she's his daughter Eva's favourite artist.
characters.flaw: You blow up first and think about it later.
characters.signature: A loud laugh, a big heart and a car stereo turned all the way up.
characters.clashReason: they'd start a shouting match over nothing

characters.name: Marcus Brooks
characters.title: The Dreamer
characters.summary: Gentle, creative and endlessly curious. You get lost in what you love, and you're always working on something new.
description: Like Marcus, you get lost in your craft. He was the restaurant's bread baker, and started experimenting with pastry after Carmy took over.
You go far to learn. Marcus trains at Noma, in Copenhagen.
You care quietly and deeply. In season 2, Marcus looks after his terminally ill mother.
characters.flaw: You get so lost in your work that you forget the world outside it.
characters.signature: Flour on your hands, a quiet focus and a dessert nobody's tried before.
characters.clashReason: they'd get so lost in their own work that they'd forget you were there

characters.name: Tina Marrero
characters.title: The Veteran
characters.summary: Tough, stubborn and secretly soft. You've seen it all, you don't take any nonsense, and once you're in, you're all in.
description: Like Tina, you're tough and you say what you think. She's an acerbic, stubborn line cook who was hired by Mikey.
You come around in the end. Tina starts out stubborn, then goes to culinary school to retrain as a sous chef.
Family keeps you going. Tina is married to David, and they have a teenage son, Louie.
characters.flaw: You dig your heels in, even when you secretly agree.
characters.signature: A hot pan, a sharp comment and a lot of experience.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly where you went wrong, and not be nice about it

characters.name: Natalie Berzatto
characters.title: The Organiser
characters.summary: Organised, caring and the one who holds it all together. You keep everyone on track, even when nobody notices.
description: Like Natalie, you're the organised one. She's Carmy's sister, and she left her bank job to become the Bear's business manager.
You hold the family together. Natalie is the middle Berzatto sibling, and she's close to Carmy.
You've always got a lot on your plate. Natalie's daughter, Sophie, is born in the season 3 episode "Ice Chips."
characters.flaw: You take care of everyone's problems, and never your own.
characters.signature: A spreadsheet, a calm voice and a to-do list as long as your arm.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask if you've done the thing you said you'd do

characters.name: Neil Fak
characters.title: The Fun One
characters.summary: Goofy, big-hearted and full of ideas. You make everyone laugh, and you never let a good scheme go to waste.
description: Like Neil, you're the fun one. He's a childhood friend of the Berzattos, and the restaurant's handyman.
You never run out of ideas. Neil and his brother Ted pitch a business idea to Uncle Jimmy, who shuts it down straight away.
You love a tradition. The Fak brothers wear matching outfits at Christmas.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a joke than take something seriously.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a terrible joke and a scheme that might just work.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn your serious moment into a joke

characters.name: Uncle Jimmy
characters.title: The Money Man
characters.summary: Shrewd, blunt and loyal to the end. You keep an eye on the numbers, and you always expect to be paid back.
description: Like Uncle Jimmy, you're the money person. He funds the restaurant, and he expects to be paid back.
You stand by family, even when it isn't blood. Jimmy was best friends with the Berzattos' father, and looked after the kids when their dad left.
You keep everyone to a deadline. In season 4, Jimmy's money man installs a countdown clock showing how long the restaurant has left.
characters.flaw: You trust numbers more than people.
characters.signature: A cheque book, a firm handshake and a deadline you mean.
characters.clashReason: they'd remind you, politely, that you still owe them

questions.text: You're hosting friends in an hour, and nothing's ready. You...

options.text: Do everything yourself, and make it perfect
Make a list, and give everyone a job
Tell everyone to stop panicking and get moving
Order pizza. Nobody needs to know

questions.text: Someone criticises your work in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Agree with them, then replay it in your head all night
Argue back, loudly, right there
Roll your eyes. You've been doing this for years
Ask what they'd change, and take notes

questions.text: Your ideal day off looks like...

options.text: Trying a new recipe again and again until you nail it
Saying you'll rest, then ending up back at work anyway
Messing around with your oldest friends, doing nothing much
Catching up on everything you didn't get done this week

questions.text: A friend asks to borrow a lot of money. You...

options.text: Lend it, with a clear date for paying it back
Give whatever you can, even if it's not much
Ask what it's for, and help them make a budget
Say no. Lending money never ends well

questions.text: Your workplace brings in a big new way of doing things. You...

options.text: Complain about it, loudly, for weeks
Learn it inside out before anyone else
Quietly keep doing your own thing, really well
Ask how much it costs, and whether it's worth it

questions.text: An argument breaks out at a big family dinner. You...

options.text: Try to calm everyone down
Stick up for whoever's getting picked on
Make a dumb joke to break the tension
Slip into the kitchen and start cooking

questions.text: You get the chance to train somewhere amazing, far from home. You...

options.text: Go, and come back with a hundred new ideas
Go, but only after planning every detail
Say it's not for you, then go anyway
Turn it down. People need you here

questions.text: Someone you care about says you've been distant lately. You...

options.text: Apologise, promise to do better, then do it again
Turn up at their door with something you made
Get defensive, then call them the next day
Tell them, bluntly, that you've got a lot on

questions.text: You're put in charge for the first time. You...

options.text: Panic quietly, then do a great job
Make sure everyone feels looked after
Say yes to everyone's ideas, and hope it all works out
Set a deadline, and make sure everyone knows it

questions.text: A friend pitches you a wild business idea. You...

options.text: Shut it down in one sentence
Love it, and ask how you can get in
Be supportive, then gently point out the problems
Nod, and say you'll think about it

questions.text: You're a top chef, and your late brother leaves you his failing sandwich shop, deep in debt. You...

options.text: Turn it into the restaurant of your dreams, whatever it takes
Keep it exactly as it was. It's what he'd want
Sell it. Debt is debt
Bring in a partner who can help you run it properly
